# AutoMate

> AutoMate is the simple, smart, private Android app for Indian car, bike and scooter owners: a mate for your auto. After setup, it records trips automatically using the phone's GPS and vehicle Bluetooth, logs FASTag tolls, and detects supported fuel payment alerts for review. No extra hardware or account is needed. Data stays on the phone; there are no AutoMate servers. Coming soon to Google Play (app ID `in.getautomate.app`), Android 12 or newer.

Key facts:

- Trips start and end automatically when the phone connects to and disconnects from the vehicle's Bluetooth (car stereo, hands-free kit or the scooter's own Bluetooth). GPS route, stops, replay, city and highway split, and trip cost. Trips can also be started by hand.
- Fuel fill-ups, FASTag tolls and other vehicle payments are picked up from payment notifications (SMS, UPI, bank and FASTag apps, Gmail previews) on the phone. AutoMate has no SMS permission.
- Also: mileage (km/L) for city and highway, expenses, garage log with service reminders (date or km), PUC and insurance reminders, and a `.automate` backup file to move to a new phone.
- FASTag features are for cars only; everything else works for bikes and scooters.
- Pricing: the first 50 trips are free, and expenses, fuel, FASTag and Garage are always free. Trips after 50 are saved but locked until a plan is bought through Google Play: ₹69 a month, or ₹999 once for life (launch price ₹799 until 31 December 2026). No ads.
- Privacy: no account, no analytics, no ads. Maps, addresses and some place lookups use Google services.
- Made in India. Contact: hello@getautomate.in
